# Sonu Thomas

> AI Software Engineer specializing in agentic systems, production LLM applications, enterprise backend architectures, and modern web platforms.

Sonu Thomas is an AI Software Engineer at HCLTech and a Data Science & Artificial Intelligence scholar at IIT Guwahati (BSc Hons, 2024–2028). With hands-on experience in software development and applied engineering, Sonu designs and evaluates scalable, reliable, and observable AI-powered systems.

## Flagship Architecture & Open Source
- **AI Prod Engg Co-Worker Platform** (https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/Prod-Engg-Co-Worker-Platform): Deploying a fleet of 100+ Core Digital Workers across 15 IT specializations—coordinated by an intelligent Central Brain—to automate ITSM, DevOps, SRE, security, and operational intelligence workflows in enterprise production environments. Reduces MTTR by 70% with LangGraph state machines, Gemini LLM, MCP protocol, ChromaDB, and real-time WebSockets.
